why: Last third of the e2e re-key: the shared tests helpers and the visual fixtures (4 Mantine-keyed files).
what: Re-key the Mantine-keyed files in e2e/desktop/tests and the visual suite's fixtures to SLOTS and data-slot, and the scheme key they write. No baseline image changes; invariants.spec.ts is not touched.
must_not_touch: the e2e/desktop dirs of the other re-key Issues
contract: Read basalt-ui docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 6.4, shutterflow docs/decisions/0028-visual-regression-gate.md (no bulk baseline regeneration) and AGENTS.md safety rule 1 (photo inputs are the owner's; never read /Volumes). basalt-ui is pinned exact next.N (the gate's floor, v3-sf-bump in `after`): its docs/recipes and llms.txt are the API truth; never edit package.json or bun.lock. Counts today (grep -il mantine over e2e/desktop, 2026-11-09): 65 .ts files, 53 specs, 30 reference mantine (the concept said 26). `SLOTS` and data-slot come from basalt-ui/testing; no data-shot attributes. Only files that reference mantine change.
exemplar: e2e/desktop/visual/invariants.spec.ts after v3-sf-scaffold for the selector style.
change: Replace each `.mantine-*`, `[data-mantine-*]` and role-by-Mantine-label selector in the owned specs and fixtures with the data-slot selector the v3 app exposes; fix the scheme key the fixtures write (`basalt:scheme`; Mantine's key only as the legacy read). No test is deleted or fixme'd without a named reason. Rule: the e2e oxlint run stays clean. Skill snippet: none.
commits: Shutterflow ships by push to master: conventional, one concern each, no attribution. Never edit node_modules or basalt-ui; a gap is a `friction:` line in the PR body.
proof: hygiene.check is false: the factory cannot run `make e2e`. Specs are owner-run at cutover; here they must list and typecheck.
acceptance: `rg -n -i mantine e2e/desktop/{tests,visual} --glob '*.ts' | rg -v 'mantine-color-scheme-value'` returns nothing, and `rg -l mantine-color-scheme-value e2e/desktop` lists at most one file (the legacy-key read)
`bun run --cwd e2e playwright test --list --project visual` lists the same tests as on origin/master
`git diff --stat origin/master -- e2e/desktop/visual` shows no *.png change
out_of_scope: Running the suites, regenerating baselines, other directories, invariants.spec.ts, app code.
